metadata.missionTarget: Lunar South Polar Permanently Shadowed Regions
metadata.psrSource: NASA LOLA South Pole Permanently Shadowed Regions (LROC)

confidenceBudget.model_name: Multi-Sensor Radar Agreement & Anomaly SNR Budget
confidenceBudget.assumptions: Confidence score is a composite metric derived from radar corroboration (both Pv and CPR positive anomaly) and spatial SNR.

volumeModel.description: Indicative Subsurface Volume Estimate derived from radar anomalous area and assumed penetration depth.

landingSites.name: Site Alpha (North Rim Plateau)
landingSites.rationale: Optimal proximity to peak volume-scattering anomaly with gentle approach corridor on northern rim plateau.

provenance.distanceToIce: Derived from geometric buffer to high-Pv anomaly centroid
provenance.slopeStatus: LOLA South-Polar Reference Baseline (live DEM pending)

landingSites.name: Site Beta (East Ridge)
landingSites.rationale: High illumination on elevated ridge; slightly higher approach slope into crater basin.

provenance.distanceToIce: Derived from geometric buffer to high-Pv anomaly centroid

landingSites.name: Site Gamma (South Approach)
landingSites.rationale: Directly adjacent to high CPR concentration but approach slope exceeds 15° limit.

provenance.distanceToIce: Derived from geometric buffer to high-Pv anomaly centroid

landingSites.name: Site Delta (Western Lowland Plain)
landingSites.rationale: Maximum terrain safety but extended traverse distance to reach subsurface ice signatures.

provenance.distanceToIce: Derived from geometric buffer to high-Pv anomaly centroid

drillSites.name: Drill Target Alpha (Max Pv Peak)
drillSites.rationale: Centroid of maximum volume scattering (Pv = 0.62) and positive CPR anomaly (+0.098).

provenance.method: Local spatial peak of Yamaguchi Pv raster within PSR boundary

drillSites.name: Drill Target Beta (Secondary Anomaly)
drillSites.rationale: Secondary concentration with elevated CPR > 1.0 signature and low single-bounce ratio.

provenance.method: Secondary cluster exceeding CPR > 1.0 within PSR
